posts.title: Surreal Time
posts.description: I feel I know what this painting means now. "The Persistence of Memory" - Salvatore Dali Retired people joke about how often they can't remember what day of the week it is. I remember one of my wife's uncles used to say about retirement that "every day is Sunday." There are days I wake up and have to take a moment or two to remember what day of the week it is. I'm usually helped out by my pill box
